narr: Thunderstorms developed along a stalled out frontal boundary, which was situated across the middle of Nebraska. As these storms tracked to the southeast, they became severe over southwestern Nebraska. Thunderstorm wind gusts up to 60 MPH were reported along with flash flooding between Lisco and Oshkosh.
